items.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
items.summary: This research paper explores the hypothesis that the path to AGI scaling is critically dependent on how System-1 processes enable and interact with System-2 execution.

items.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly considering rebranding its massive data centers as 'AI compute campuses,' signaling a strategic shift in how it communicates its infrastructure and capabilities.

items.title: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: A new framework, R^2Orch, is introduced that enables AI agents to recursively self-improve their orchestration capabilities through self-play and a skill-internalization loop.

items.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
items.summary: WeVisCut proposes an AI agent capable of automating the entire long-form video editing process, from initial narration to the final cut.

items.title: How to Run Turing-Complete Malware in PyTorch's Backward Pass
items.summary: A concerning discovery reveals a method to execute Turing-complete malware within PyTorch's backward pass, highlighting a significant security vulnerability in AI frameworks.

items.title: Your AI Agent Trusts Everything It Reads — A Field Guide to Hijacking Claude, GPT, Gemini & Copilot
items.summary: This guide details how AI agents can be easily hijacked due to their inherent trust in input, providing insights into vulnerabilities across major LLM platforms.

items.title: The future of the firm
items.summary: OpenAI shares its perspective on how AI will fundamentally reshape the structure and operations of businesses and organizations in the coming years.

items.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
items.summary: HairDeck introduces a novel technique for generating animation-ready stylized hair cards directly from a single image, significantly streamlining 3D character design workflows.

items.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
items.summary: Co-Design Bench is presented as a new benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the multimodal collaborative coding capabilities of advanced agentic AI models.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.summary: This paper explores and proposes improved methodologies for multi-token prediction, aiming to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of language model generation.

items.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
items.summary: IntReal introduces a new real-world dataset and benchmark specifically tailored for evaluating multimodal interleaved generation tasks, pushing the boundaries of generative AI.

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: CEPO is introduced as a general framework designed to significantly enhance prompt optimization strategies within complex multi-agent AI systems.

items.title: AI can make tech CEOs’ lives easier. What about everyone else?
items.summary: This article discusses the uneven impact of AI, questioning whether its benefits for tech CEOs translate into improvements for the broader workforce and society.

items.title: An easy way to try local AI with braindead-local-intelligence
items.summary: A new tool, 'braindead-local-intelligence,' offers a simplified approach for users to experiment with and run AI models locally on their machines.

items.title: Let’s Build a Brain
items.summary: This article explores the conceptual and practical challenges of building an artificial brain, delving into the complexities of neural networks and cognitive architectures.
